text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":20,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"bought 20 marbles"},{"id":"q2","value":50,"unit":"marbles","kind":"count","span":"store that had 50"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2/5 times as"},{"id":"q4","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2/5 times as"},{"id":"q5","value":2,"unit":"kg","kind":"count","span":"weighs 2kgs"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"marbles in store after Solomon added his 20 to the existing 50"},{"op":"div","args":["q1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"one-fifth of what Solomon bought from Johanna"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"father's marbles = two-fifths of what Solomon bought from Johanna"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"total marbles in store after the father's gift"},{"op":"mul","args":["s4","q5"],"out":"s5","note":"total weight = total marbles times weight per marble"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total weight of all marbles Solomon has in the store"},"dismissed":[]}
